19-year-old Zagłębie Lubin midfielder Marcel Regula was heavily linked with a move to Borussia Dortmund during the summer transfer window, but ultimately remained in Poland.

According to Bild, however, the Black and Yellows have not given up on their pursuit of the youngster and could make another attempt to bring him to Germany when the transfer window reopens in January.

However, Dortmund may need to sell a player first to make room for Regula in the squad.

One of the 19-year-old's biggest strengths is his versatility. A natural attacking midfielder, Regula can also operate on either wing or lead the line.

He has scored two goals in nine games for Zagłębie Lubin so far this season.

articles.title: Report card from Nebraska's ugly 31-13 win over Michigan State
articles.summary: Nebraska took another step in the right direction this past weekend. However, despite the 31-13 win for the Huskers, it wasn’t pretty.
articles.body:
Nebraska football took another step in the right direction this past weekend, improving to 4-0 for the first time since 2016. The Huskers won their Big Ten opener over Michigan State 31-13 on the road and have an opportunity to improve to 5-0 with Maryland on deck.

However, despite the 31-13 win for the Huskers, it wasn't pretty. At multiple points in the game, Michigan State had the opportunity to win. Whether it was the offense hitting a brick wall, the defense allowing drives, or special teams escaping disaster. Safe to say, there's a lot to unpack here.

Here is the report card from Nebraska 's ugly win over Michigan State.

Anthony Colandrea faced adversity on Saturday with Michigan State's defense. The Spartans managed to flush him out of the pocket, force the ball out and make sure he couldn't find his target in time.

This led to Colandrea going 15-of-27 in the air and even fumbling once. But that was for about half of the game. In the other half of the game, Colandrea produced over 200 passing yards, two passing touchdowns and even 66 rushing yards.

That's a good sign for a Nebraska quarterback. Colandrea stayed calm and produced key plays when the Huskers needed them. Also, Michigan State's defense, despite its flaws, has frustrated quarterbacks at times this season. So, this was a good test for Colandrea.

However, he still needs to correct a few off-target throws that either just missed a receiver or disrupted what would have been catches in stride. Colandrea's run-pass decisions also were back-and-forth at times with the opposite decision looking better in hindsight. All in all, a solid performance against a solid team, but the competition will get tougher.

For the first time this season, the run game faced a fierce defense, making Colandrea Nebraska's top runner. Much of that was because Michigan State cranked up the pressure. Yet, despite struggling at times and even Jamal Rule getting injured, the group still put together a solid outing.

Rule left early after the Spartans zeroed in on him whenever he was on the field, and he finished with just four yards on four carries. Mekhi Nelson took the bulk of the load, instead, earning 61 yards on 15 carries, broke out a few big gains, and even fought for a touchdown. Isaiah Mozee also picked up 23 yards on seven carries.

Vincent Genatone stepped up for the Huskers, however, scoring twice, marking his first two touchdowns in his career. Genatone first scored on a 13-yard reception in the second quarter, then punched in a game-sealing touchdown from one yard out in the fourth.

This group will continue to face more pressure-heavy defenses and will need to keep bringing grit on every carry. They may have to make things happen from the second the ball enters their hands. But at full strength, Nebraska's running backs can be dangerous.

Kwazi Gilmer totaled only four receptions, but three were beyond 15 yards. Those catches came at three key moments for Nebraska. Gilmer snatched an early 17-yard pass to get the offense going, before capping off the drive with a massive 44-yard touchdown grab. Then he caught a big 38-yard pass on third down in the fourth.

Luke Lindenmeyer also finished with four catches for 25 yards. One reception came just before halftime and set up Genatone for a score. Quinn Clark secured a couple of key receptions, including a 25-yard snatch in the red zone.

The group didn't end the night clean, however. Gilmer got flagged for a holding penalty. Lindenmeyer was tagged for illegal formation, and Jacory Barney Jr. fumbled on his only reception of the game.

Michigan State was down bad in the secondary as well, which should've led to a more lights-out performance from the receiving corps. Though the Spartans fought on all fronts, an alright showcase against non-starters does not paint a smooth road for Nebraska.

The pipeline faced its toughest opponent yet this season and overall won half of its battles. The Spartans finished with three tackles for loss and swallowed up the run half the time.

However, Colandrea wasn't sacked once again, and Michigan State sent defensive backs in to blow up runs. Plus, the line found its footing as the game went on, allowing the Huskers to pull away and get key scores. Yet the issues remained through the final drive.

Nebraska failed on a fourth-and-short with a 24-13 lead, giving Michigan State the window to come back. Fortunately, the Spartans came up empty-handed, and Nebraska scored on a goal-line run on the preceding drive. Pair that with the line's early woes and two false-start penalties, and plenty of wrinkles remain to iron out.

Nebraska finished with six sacks and 10 tackles for loss. That kind of success doesn't just happen, especially when both stats are season highs. The Huskers were a nightmare for the Spartans at times, disrupting promising drives and giving their offense a chance to rebound.

Williams Nwaneri headed the line, getting two sacks on the night. Jahsear Whittington also got one sack, helping the group earn a hat trick. Riley Van Poppel also breached the backfield, earning a tackle for loss.

But while the line did tremendous, one key factor was missing. Cam Edwards and a few other plays went down for Michigan State's offense, which kept what could've been a more aggressive or controlling Spartan attack in check.

The defense got flustered at times too, including when Nwaneri was penalized for an illegal substitution. Van Poppel also got a personal foul that was enforced on the kickoff, which could be a crucial moment in future games if Nebraska needs a special teams play.

Nebraska's linebackers also made a big impact, allowing only one runner to get past 10 yards. But arguably its play of the game was Owen Chambliss , who picked off Cam Fancher in the second quarter. Chambliss also led the team with eight tackles. Dawson Meritt, meanwhile, got to the quarterback for the group's only sack of the day.

Those were the highlights of the game for the second level. However, its aerial defense wasn't flawless. Chambliss pick overshadowed some short throws that turned into double-digit gains for the Spartans, allowing for drives to continue and even leading to scores. Vincent Shavers Jr. also got a holding penalty that restarted a drive for Michigan State, leading to a field goal.

Though the Spartans couldn't fully exploit such mistakes, other teams like Iowa , Oregon and Indiana can, without a doubt. For now, this was an alright night for the group. But they need to keep making big plays if they want to negate offenses moving the ball.

Michigan State's secondary wasn't the only one that invaded the backfield. The Huskers totaled two sacks and three other tackles for loss, along with one interception. Those are big plays for Nebraska. But, the night was anything but perfect.

Milivojevic still finished 18-of-26 for 208 yards, but his final string of throws was critical. He completed five straight throws that delivered Michigan State from its own eight to the Nebraska 18. Though Andrew Marshall shut the drive down with an interception shortly after, allowing the Spartans to get down there in the first place is problematic.

Drives like that can be turned into topple plays like Jamir Conn getting a sack while in pursuit, or Donovan Jones shooting out of a cannon the second he locked onto Alessio Milivojevic , stripping him of the ball and recovering it. Those plays ended potential scoring drives for the Spartans, but they could be in vain if Michigan State managed to put together two more drives.

That's not to say those big plays by the Huskers should be tossed aside, because they shouldn't. Delivering sacks, securing interceptions and even zeroing in on receivers once the ball hits them are all much needed aspects for this secondary. Next, they need to keep plays downfield from happening and keep ball carriers in front of defenders.

Barney and Nyziah Hunter each only had one return on the day. Barney took a punt 12 yards. Hunter returned a kickoff for 18. Wilson once again delivered three punts, all of them for over 40 yards and one pinning Michigan State inside its own 20.

Kyle Cunanan also kicked a chip-shot field goal for the Huskers at a point in the game that made it a three-score game. Nwaneri was even credited for the blocked field goal.

But the only big special-teams play of the day was fortunately negated. Archie Wilson's second punt of the game was blocked. But a holding penalty turned it into a fresh set of downs for Nebraska, and its eventual 44-yard touchdown.

That alone is problematic, considering how special teams mishaps have doomed Nebraska in the past. Hopefully that's the only mishap for the Huskers this season. But it can't be ignored, especially when Nebraska did make a few plays.

articles.title: Santos FC get Hypershell exoskeletons for use in professional football
articles.summary: Santos FC received seven exoskeletons from Hypershell, including the Hypershell X Ultra S, the flagship model of the company’s new generation of smart exoske...
articles.body:
Santos FC received seven exoskeletons from Hypershell, including the Hypershell X Ultra S, the flagship model of the company's new generation of smart exoskeletons. The equipment will now become part of the professional football work environment at CT Rei Pelé, where it will be evaluated by the Club's staff for applications related to recovery and gradual return to activity, strength and endurance training, post-match recovery, and load management.

The delivery was accompanied by technical training led by physiotherapist Gustavo Balieiro, technical specialist at Hypershell Brazil and a professional working with exoskeletons and technologies applied to human movement. Balieiro holds a postgraduate degree in Neurological Rehabilitation from the Albert Einstein Israeli Hospital, where he also worked as a senior physiotherapist at the Rehabilitation Center.

During the training, the operation of the exoskeletons, the different levels of assistance and resistance, and the possibilities for integrating the technology into high-performance football routines were presented.

The new technology may be used in sessions supervised by professionals from the Club's Physiotherapy department and other health and performance areas, who will evaluate its application in different training, recovery, and gradual return activities. The goal is to build practical knowledge about the equipment and understand in which situations the assistance or resistance provided by the exoskeleton can add value to the methods already used by Santos FC.

Hypershell uses high-performance electric motors, sensors, and artificial intelligence to continuously interpret the user's movement pattern and adjust the motors' action in real time. In the X Ultra S, the HyperIntuition™ system coordinates this response according to the characteristics of the movement, allowing both assistance and programmed resistance.

For professional football, three areas were highlighted during the technical presentation: recovery and gradual return to activity, strength and endurance training, and post-match recovery with load management. The equipment serves as a complementary tool, with its use defined and supervised by the professionals responsible for the athletes.

"More than delivering exoskeletons to Santos FC, our goal was to put the technology in the hands of the professionals who work daily with high-performance athletes. During the training, we were able to discuss real applications for recovery, strengthening, training, and load management. Now begins an even more important phase, which is evaluating Hypershell within the real routine of professional football," says Wesley Moser Marques, director of UBTEC, Hypershell's importer in Brazil.

Hypershell is a Chinese technology company specializing in the development of smart exoskeletons, combining robotics, electric motors, sensors, and artificial intelligence applied to human movement.

In Brazil, the products are imported by UBTEC, which is responsible for Hypershell Brazil's operations, technical support, training, and the development of projects and partnerships.

articles.title: Former presidential candidate Enrique Riquelme addresses Real Madrid refereeing complaints and Florentino Perez tension
articles.summary: Former Real Madrid presidential candidate Enrique Riquelme has addressed the controversy surrounding his appearance at Atletico Madrid’s Metropolitano during...
articles.body:
Former Real Madrid presidential candidate Enrique Riquelme has addressed the controversy surrounding his appearance at Atletico Madrid 's Metropolitano during Real Madrid's derby defeat.

It must be remembered that Riquelme's presence at the stadium reportedly created tension because of his history as a challenger to Florentino Perez in the club's presidential race.

The Spanish businessman, though, played down the significance of the episode and insisted that the presidential election is now in the past.

His message was that fans and members of the club should remain united behind the team.

"I didn't hear about the story until later, from the press. I mean, I was there – I was invited to go – and obviously, as a Real Madrid fan, and as I've said on several occasions, the elections are over, and now we all need to pull together.

"The Real Madrid family, at this moment, must stand united, with no turmoil or unnecessary fuss. The Real Madrid family must stand united, and that's certainly how I'll be acting," he told COPE .

Riquelme wants Real Madrid united after presidential race

Riquelme's comments were consistent with his position that the election campaign should not divide the club.

Enrique Riquelme addressed potential tension with Florentino Perez. (Photo by Denis Doyle/Getty Images)

He also reflected on his previous proposals for Real Madrid , including his interest in players such as Erling Haaland and Rodri .

Both players subsequently enjoyed major success with their national team at the World Cup, something Riquelme pointed to when discussing his earlier plans.

Asked about people who miss the possibility of having Haaland and Rodri at Real Madrid, he responded:

"Well, as I said, the elections are over. My proposals were clear, they were out in the open, and they've had – as we anticipated – a brilliant World Cup.

"So now, I wish the Real Madrid players the best of luck and hope they bring us some trophies this year."

Riquelme addresses Real Madrid's refereeing complaints

The former presidential candidate was also asked about Real Madrid's complaints surrounding refereeing decisions, particularly after the controversial derby defeat to Atletico Madrid.

Riquelme pointed to the subjective nature of football and the difficulty of achieving complete agreement over contentious decisions.

Enrique Riquelme wants unity at Real Madrid. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images)

"The beauty of football is that, even for different teams, the same play can lead to completely divergent opinions, and both sides are convinced they're right.

"Going back to the campaign, I think what happened with Barcelona and the referees at the time was a disaster, and I believe this is now more of a day-to-day occurrence.

"VAR is providing partial solutions and will surely continue to improve so that these controversies become less frequent," he explained.

Riquelme is completely behind Real Madrid

Despite having challenged Perez during the presidential process, Riquelme made clear that his support for Real Madrid has not changed.

He intends to continue attending matches and supporting the team regardless of whether he is in Spain or travelling abroad.

"I hope, I'm confident, I hope, and I'll be there to cheer them on at most of the matches, whether I'm in Spain or abroad; of course, I'll go to support them just like any other member," he concluded.

articles.title: Golden goal from Olise; Ito and Kim also in action
articles.summary: Dayot Upamecano and Michael Olise contested their second UEFA Nations League match with France on Monday. Minjae Kim and Hiroki Ito were also in action in fr...
articles.body:
Dayot Upamecano and Michael Olise contested their second UEFA Nations League match with France on Monday. Minjae Kim and Hiroki Ito were also in action in friendlies. fcbayern.com with an overview:

Olise scored the decisive goal in the French national team 's 1–0 (0–0) win over Belgium in Brussels. Coach Zinedine Zidane brought on the Bayern forward in the 77th minute and he bagged the winner two minutes from time. Olise had won the ball in his own half and, after a spectacular solo run across half the pitch, finished with a low shot from around 15 metres – leaving Belgium's goalkeeper Lammens with no chance.

The match was evenly balanced for a long period, before Olise's strike broke the Belgians' hearts in the midst of a period of intense French pressure just before the end. Dayot Upamecano didn't feature in the game. The French Football Federation was full of praise for the 24-year-old Bayern striker's goal on its website, writing: "What a piece of skill!".

On Friday, at the Stade de France, the Equipe Tricolore now face Italy , who secured a resounding 4–1 win in Turkey.

Ito and Japan celebrated their second win in their second match of this international break on Monday. The Bayern defender came off the bench in the second half of the 2–1 (0–0) win over Venezuela in the 2026 Kirin Challenge Cup in Hiroshima.

The visitors took the lead shortly after the break through Kevin Kelsy (46'). Ayase Ueda (49') quickly equalised, before sealing victory for the hosts with a penalty in stoppage time (90'+6). Japan's next match in the 2026 Kirin Cup is against Ecuador on Thursday.

The South Korea n national team, featuring Minjae Kim, had an off day in their friendly against Uruguay and were beaten 4–1 (3–0) by the South Americans. The Bayern centre-back was in his country's starting XI, just as he had been four days earlier in the 3–0 win over Ecuador, and was taken off at half-time.

Darwin Núñez put Uruguay ahead in the 13th minute then Giorgian de Arrascaeta (27') doubled the lead, before Minjae Kim, who had a day to forget, scored an own goal in the 43rd minute. Núñez then got a second in the 62nd minute to make it 4–0, before Lee Kang-in (80') at least managed to salvage some pride for the hosts. South Korea's next friendly is on Friday, when they take on Venezuela at home.

articles.title: Kayode impresses on Italy debut as duel with Palestra emerges
articles.summary: Most Italian newspapers named Brentford defender Michael Kayode their Man of the Match after Italy’s 4-1 victory over Türkiye, with the 22-year-old capping a...
articles.body:
Most Italian newspapers named Brentford defender Michael Kayode their Man of the Match after Italy 's 4-1 victory over Türkiye, with the 22-year-old capping an impressive debut by scoring his first goal with the Azzurri.

Brentford defender Kayode made an impressive senior debut for Italy on Monday, contributing to the Azzurri's 4-1 away win against Turkey with a first-half goal.

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Michael Kayode of Italy celebrates scoring his team's third goal with teammate Sandro Tonali during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)

Kayode also played a part in Italy's second goal of the night, scored by Davide Frattesi , who tapped home after the Turkish goalkeeper had denied the Brentford defender's initial effort.

Gazzetta and Corriere della Sera picked Kayode as the MOTM in Bursa last night, rating him 7/10.

"Socks rolled down and a languid stride. In Bura, he put his name on the scoresheet for the first time. A goal and a commanding performance. He's flying," wrote Gazzetta.

"The plan is for Palestra, currently sidelined with an injury, to be the long-term starter on the wing. But who is going to take him out of that spot now?" asked Corriere della Sera.

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Michael Kayode of Italy crosses the ball under pressure from Eren Elmal of Turkiye during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)

Palestra made his senior Italy debut this past March, making two appearances under Gennaro Gattuso in Italy's unsuccessful World Cup play-off campaign.

The former Cagliari and Atalanta defender joined Chelsea on a deal worth €60m last summer, but he's been injured for weeks and has yet to make his competitive debut for the Blues.

SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA – AUGUST 01: Marco Palestra of Chelsea looks on during the Sydney Super Cup match between Chelsea FC and Tottenham at Accor Stadium on August 01, 2026 in Sydney, Australia. (Photo by Brendon Thorne/Getty Images)

Corriere dello Sport rated Kayode 7.5/10 but gave Sandro Tonali the MOTM award with an 8/10 rating.

Tuttosport also rated Kayode 7.5/10, describing his debut as "magical."

Kayode had already left his mark for the Azzurri at a youth level, scoring the winning goal in the Euro U19 Final against Portugal in 2023. That team's coach, Alberto Bollini, is now Roberto Mancini's assistant coach.

Find out more about Kayode's career in the video below, which we published on YouTube after attending Kayode's first Italy press conference at Coverciano last week.

articles.body: Pipi Estrada, Irene Junquera, Nacho Palencia, Ricardo Rosety, Fernando Polo y Javier Tintó han sido los tertulianos de este martes en La Tribu, patrocinada por Sportium durante esta temporada, para analizar la actualidad deportiva marcada por el partido de la selección ante Croacia y el debate entorno al Balón de Oro. Pipi Estrada. "Hay una campaña entorno a Lamine y a Mbappé y no lo va a ganar ninguno. Hay dos tapados: uno Rodri y otro Harry Kane. El que debería ganar el Balón de Oro es Fabián". Irene Junquera. "A Messi le dieron un Balón de Oro por los goles. El Balón de Oro es subjetividad". Nacho Palencia. "Pedri y Fabián pueden jugar juntos perfectamente. El Mundial que hizo Messi es de matrícula de honor". Ricardo Rosety. "En el momento en el que das mucho peso al Mundial, Messi tiene que estar arriba". Fernando Polo. "El Barça está haciendo campaña por Lamine, pero Rodri en su foro interno también está metiendo la patita. Pero como acaba de llegar y tiene a un canterano con el 10 del Barça... se tiene que doblegar". Javier Tintó "Fuera de España Fabián es más que Pedri y Raya más que Unai Simón y Joan García. Pedri no tiene que estar en el Balón de Oro, no ha hecho un año para estar. Fabián es mucho más jugador que Pedri y lo preguntas en cualquier liga europeo y te lo van a decir. Y mejor que Valverde. Fabián es un jugador que no está valorado. Y para el Madrid 1.500 veces le elijo antes que Rodri. Es un futbolista moderno".

articles.title: Liverpool star Jeremy Jacquet delivers honest verdict on France debut
articles.summary: Liverpool centre-back Jeremy Jacquet was not satisfied with his performance in France’s 1-0 victory at Belgium in the UEFA Nations League on Monday.The 21-ye...
articles.body:
Liverpool centre-back Jeremy Jacquet was not satisfied with his performance in France 's 1-0 victory at Belgium in the UEFA Nations League on Monday.

The 21-year-old enjoyed a solid debut performance alongside Chelsea's Maxence Lacroix , helping France keep a second consecutive clean sheet.

French journalist Walid Acherchour praised the centre-back, describing him as the ' real deal ' and saying that he has all the qualities of a modern defender.

However, Jacquet, reacting to his performance after the game, believes that he could have done better.

"It's true that as a defender, a clean sheet is the best thing you can do. Especially with the win at the end. I can only be happy," he told the media .

"But I am not satisfied. I think back to two or three attacking balls, I can do better once I recover. Overall I'm happy, we're leaving with the three points and the clean sheet."

The Liverpool youngster is aware of the competition he faces in France's squad, and that may explain his self-critical assessment.

Upamecano and William Saliba were the first-choice centre-back pairing at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with Lacroix and Ibrahima Konate providing cover for them.

Jacquet will be looking to get further opportunities to impress head coach Zinedine Zidane in Friday's encounter against Italy and the return fixture against Belgium next Monday.

Meanwhile, he is one of the eight nominees for the Premier League's Player of the Month for September after helping Liverpool keep three consecutive clean sheets.

Jacquet could become the first France international to win the award in 11 years.

articles.title: FIFA accuses UEFA of ‘misinformation campaign’ over Infantino’s plan
articles.summary: FIFA has launched an attack on European football body UEFA, accusing it of running a “misinformation campaign” to scupper Gianni Infantino’s World Cup privat...
articles.body:
FIFA has launched an attack on European football body UEFA, accusing it of running a "misinformation campaign" to scupper Gianni Infantino's World Cup private investor proposal.

A legal filing on FIFA's behalf in the US courts said it would have been a "dereliction of duty" if Infantino had not explored the FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal, which he ultimately was forced to abandon after the plan was rejected by UEFA, along with the two other continental confederations.

The filing, seen by the Press Association, was made in the District Court of South Florida, where FIFA is opposing a motion by UEFA for the disclosure of documents related to FFE.

The claim rejects any suggestion that Infantino stood to gain personally from FFE, adding that the proposal would have needed ratification from FIFA's 211 member national associations as well as the FIFA Council.

UEFA is accused of making the application "for the purposes of harassment, rather than out of any legitimate need for discovery. That alone is an independent basis for denial."

Arguably the most damaging claim made by European football's governing body in its original application is that FFE was given a "fraudulently off-market" valuation of $20 billion.

FIFA has now countered by saying UEFA has conflated equity value with enterprise value. It said the enterprise value was "more than twice" that of the equity value.

"UEFA would have learned all of this had it bothered to verify its assertions before publicly decrying the proposal or filing in federal court," the FIFA filing said.

UEFA has stated it has lost confidence in Infantino despite the abandonment of FFE, and that it is seeking to put up a credible alternative candidate to stand against him in next year's presidential election.

FIFA's filing questions the timing of UEFA's legal application, noting that the deadline for candidates to be submitted is November 18.

"This court should reject any attempt to influence FIFA's presidential election based on these grounds," the filings state.

UEFA has been approached for comment by PA.

articles.title: Niklas Süle, de central en la Bundesliga... ¡a portero en Novena división!
articles.standfirst: El ex de Hoffenheim, Dortmund y Bayern se encuentra jugando en el Tiefenbach
articles.summary: El ex de Hoffenheim, Dortmund y Bayern se encuentra jugando en el Tiefenbach
articles.body: Hay jugadores que tratan de 'estirar el chicle' lo máximo posible. Los menos, como Niklas Süle, simplemente quieren ser felices. El pasado mes de junio, todavía con 30 años, tomó la decisión de dejar el Borussia Dortmund y poner punto y final a su carrera. Al menos, a nivel profesional. "Me gustaría anunciar que terminaré mi carrera este verano. Tengo muy clara mi decisión. A pesar de ello, el fútbol me ha dado muchísimo y he tenido un tiempo tan genial que duele decir esto". Víctima de hasta cinco lesiones diferentes a lo largo de la temporada pasada que apenas le permitieron disputar 13 partidos con el Borussia Dortmund, expuso que la decisión fue tomada después de sufrir una lesión de rodilla que le hizo temer que debía ser operado. No quería pasar por eso y decidió que era el momento de parar. "Cuando recibí la noticia de que el ligamento no estaba roto, para mí quedó claro que se había acabado. No podía imaginarme nada peor que estar esperando con ilusión el tiempo tras la retirada, siendo independiente, yendo de vacaciones, pasando tiempo con mis hijos... y luego tener que procesar mi tercera rotura de cruzado". El 'gusanillo', sin embargo, le seguía picando... y decidió bajar hasta la Novena división del fútbol alemán para seguir disfrutando del fútbol en el humilde Tiefenbach. Un escenario poco común en un futbolista que, además de haber sido internacional con Alemania en 49 ocasiones, ha ganado una Champions, cinco Bundesligas, dos POKAL... "Me alegra mucho poder vivir el fútbol por fin desde un punto de vista completamente diferente: allí donde se trata únicamente del deporte en sí y no de un negocio o del dinero", explicaba Süle. "Además, en el SV Tiefenbach juegan dos de mis mejores amigos, uno de los cuales incluso es entrenador aquí. Después de 13 años como futbolista profesional, es un regalo absoluto para mí poder estar en el campo con mis colegas y disfrutar de nuevo a tope de este maravilloso deporte". Durante estos meses, se han hecho bastante 'virales' algunos vídeos de sus partidos realizando 'tackles', disputando duelos aéreos... Lo que nadie podía esperarse a estas alturas de la película es que, en cuestión de cuatro meses, pasase de jugar como central en la Bundesliga... ¡a enfundarse los guantes en novena división! Todo, porque el portero habitual del Tiefenbach no estaba disponible.

articles.title: Una nueva dimensión para Marc Roca: la IA confirma su paso adelante
articles.standfirst: Los datos de Olocip by Plexus Sport ponen cifras al gran comienzo de temporada del catalán
articles.summary: Los datos de Olocip by Plexus Sport ponen cifras al gran comienzo de temporada del catalán
articles.body: Marc Roca ha encontrado una nueva dimensión en el centro del campo del Betis. No tanto porque participe más en el juego, sino porque sus acciones están teniendo una mayor trascendencia para su equipo. Los datos permiten poner cifras a las buenas sensaciones que está dejando el centrocampista catalán en este comienzo de temporada, en el que ha elevado de manera significativa su influencia tanto con balón como en el trabajo defensivo. Así lo refleja el análisis de Olocip by Plexus Sport, compañía especializada en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial al deporte. Su modelo no se limita a contabilizar pases, recuperaciones, duelos, disparos o cualquier otra acción realizada por un futbolista. Después de ser entrenado mediante el análisis de millones de acciones de partidos, estudia más de 60 variables y trata de determinar el valor real que genera cada intervención en función del contexto en el que se produce. La clave está precisamente ahí. No todos los pases acertados tienen el mismo valor, como tampoco lo tienen dos recuperaciones o dos duelos ganados. Un pase horizontal sin oposición en campo propio no tiene la misma trascendencia que uno que permite superar una línea de presión, del mismo modo que recuperar un balón lejos de la portería propia no supone lo mismo que hacerlo cuando el rival amenaza con generar una ocasión. El modelo analiza cómo cada una de esas acciones modifica las probabilidades de que el equipo marque un gol o lo encaje. A partir de ahí, Olocip agrupa las acciones en diferentes parcelas del juego, entre ellas defensa, construcción y ataque, y establece un valor de rendimiento que, normalizado por 90 minutos, permite comparar la influencia de un futbolista entre distintas temporadas aunque el número de minutos disputados sea diferente. En definitiva, un completo análisis numérico que confirma con cifras las buenas sensaciones que el catalán está ofreciendo en un rol un poco diferente al de años atrás, más como mediocentro posicional que como 'box to box'. Es ahí donde aparece el importante salto de Marc Roca. Su valoración global en este comienzo de LaLiga alcanza los 0,30 por 90 minutos, exactamente el doble de los 0,15 que registró durante la pasada temporada. Un crecimiento que adquiere todavía más significado al comprobar dónde se está produciendo ya que su impacto en construcción ha pasado de 0,03 a 0,14 por 90 minutos, más de cuatro veces el registro de la temporada anterior y su mejor dato desde que llegó al Betis. La evolución, además, resulta especialmente llamativa al analizar sus pases... Marc Roca mantiene un volumen elevado, con 51,46 pases de media por 90 minutos, pero la diferencia no está tanto en cuánto interviene como en para qué están sirviendo esas intervenciones. El valor generado por sus pases ha pasado de -0,0059 por 90 minutos la pasada temporada a 0,1143 en la actual, una variación que refleja una mayor trascendencia de sus acciones a la hora de dar continuidad al juego, superar líneas de presión y hacer avanzar al equipo desde campo propio. El salto es igualmente significativo sin balón. Su valoración en defensa ha aumentado de 0,09 a 0,18 por 90 minutos, duplicando el dato de la pasada campaña y alcanzando también su mejor registro desde que viste de verdiblanco. En este apartado destacan sus 4,77 duelos defensivos en el suelo completados por 90 minutos, sus 1,99 interceptaciones y su aportación bloqueando remates. De hecho, la fotografía que dejan los datos resulta especialmente interesante si se compara con su trayectoria completa en Heliópolis. Marc Roca alcanzó en la temporada 2024-25 su valoración global más alta, con 0,33 por 90 minutos, frente al 0,30 actual. Pero entonces su aportación ofensiva tenía un peso considerablemente mayor. En este inicio de curso, en cambio, está alcanzando sus mejores registros como jugador del Betis tanto en defensa como en construcción, precisamente las dos parcelas que más definen su función en el doble pivote. Este salto de rendimiento coincide además con una cifra simbólica en su trayectoria. A sus 29 años, Marc Roca acaba de alcanzar los 100 partidos oficiales con el Betis, 79 de ellos como titular, acumulando 6.949 minutos, siete goles y nueve asistencias, según los datos de BDFutbol. En este centenar de encuentros ha visto 16 tarjetas amarillas y no ha sufrido ninguna expulsión, un detalle de lo más relevante tratándose de un futbolista clave en el balance defensivo, en las coberturas y que en ocasiones está expuesto en los contraataques rivales. Sus partidos se reparten entre cinco competiciones: 74 en LaLiga, 14 en la Europa League, seis en la Copa del Rey, cinco en la Conference League y uno en la Champions League, competición en la que ya tuvo la oportunidad de participar hace años como futbolista del Bayern de Munich y a la que ha podido regresar esta temporada con la camiseta verdiblanca. El recorrido comenzó en el verano de 2023. Marc Roca aterrizó entonces en Heliópolis cedido por el Leeds United para la temporada 2023-24. Su rendimiento convenció al Betis y, un año después, el club verdiblanco alcanzó un acuerdo con el conjunto inglés para hacerse definitivamente con sus derechos y firmarle un contrato hasta junio de 2029. Tres años después de aquella primera cesión, Roca ha alcanzado el centenario convertido en uno de los futbolistas con mayor recorrido de la actual plantilla. Y lo hace mostrando una versión diferente. Menos relacionada con la producción ofensiva y mucho más determinante en la recuperación y en el nacimiento de las jugadas. Una nueva dimensión para un Marc Roca cuyo paso adelante ya no responde únicamente a sensaciones: la Inteligencia Artificial también le pone cifras.

articles.title: El Valencia detalla el proceso para la elección de asientos en el Nou Mestalla
articles.standfirst: El proceso para elegir asiento en el estadio arrancará en octubre de 2026 y culminará con la campaña de abonos del verano de 2027.
articles.summary: El proceso para elegir asiento en el estadio arrancará en octubre de 2026 y culminará con la campaña de abonos del verano de 2027.
articles.body: El Valencia ha dado a conocer el calendario que seguirán sus socios y abonados para seleccionar su ubicación en el Nou Mestalla, un proceso que se desarrollará entre octubre de 2026 y julio de 2027 y que servirá para organizar el traslado al nuevo estadio previsto para el verano de 2027. La primera fase tendrá lugar entre el 14 y el 30 de octubre de 2026 y estará destinada a la creación de grupos de forma telemática. Durante ese periodo, los aficionados podrán agruparse con familiares, amigos o miembros de peñas para optar posteriormente a localidades contiguas. La segunda fase comenzará el 17 de noviembre y se prolongará hasta finales de mayo de 2027. Consistirá en la elección presencial de asientos en la sala 1923 de Mestalla. La tercera etapa, prevista para junio y julio de 2027, corresponderá a la formalización administrativa y al pago de los abonos para la temporada 2027-28. Coincidiendo con el anuncio del procedimiento, el club también ha difundido nuevos detalles sobre la distribución y funcionamiento del Nou Mestalla. El estadio organizará sus localidades mediante una orientación cardinal. Los laterales quedarán identificados como Este y Oeste, mientras que los fondos serán Norte y Sur, como suele aplicarse habitualmente en los estadios de fútbol. El graderío está dividido en cuatro niveles principales. La grada baja ocupará los sectores numerados del 100 al 141; la grada media, del 200 al 258; la grada alta, del 300 al 352; y la grada superior, del 400 al 452. Entre la grada media y la alta se situará una zona específica de hospitality y servicios premium, con capacidad para 6.500 personas, en diferentes modalidades y servicios. Entre las áreas diferenciadas del recinto figurará la grada de animación, ubicada en los sectores 116 al 119 del fondo norte y con capacidad para 2.235 espectadores. También se reservarán espacios específicos para la afición visitante, con un aforo de 853 localidades en competiciones nacionales y ampliable hasta 3.495 en partidos de competiciones UEFA. El proyecto contempla además un aumento de las localidades adaptadas para personas con movilidad reducida. Frente a las aproximadamente 40 plazas disponibles en Mestalla, el nuevo estadio dispondrá de 137 espacios adaptados distribuidos entre distintas zonas del recinto. La mayoría se situarán en la última fila de la grada baja junto a los asientos destinados a sus acompañantes. En cuanto a la circulación interior, el club prevé accesos diferenciados según la ubicación de cada localidad. Los sectores de grada baja y media tendrán entrada desde el perímetro exterior a nivel de calle, mientras que las localidades de grada alta y superior estarán conectadas mediante doce torres de comunicación vertical que distribuirán el flujo de espectadores hacia las zonas más elevadas del estadio.

articles.title: Javi Rodríguez busca recuperar su mejor nivel
articles.standfirst: Futbolista clave para Giráldez
articles.summary: Futbolista clave para Giráldez
articles.body: Javi Rodríguez es un jugador esencial en el actual Celta, un futbolista clave para Claudio Giráldez pese a su juventud como certifican los 40 y 46 partidos que disputó las dos últimas temporadas. Su notable rendimiento le llevó a debutar con la selección española absoluta hace apenas cuatro meses. Sin embargo en el arranque de esta temporada su participación ha descendido, buscando que encuentre su mejor estado de forma. El defensa de 23 años no ha disputado los tres últimos encuentros de Liga, situación que no había conocido desde su salto al primer equipo céltico. En ese espacio de tiempo participó en el partido de Europa Legue ante Omonia Nicosia en Chipre. Únicamente disputó completos, en Liga, los dos primeros partidos, ante el Athletic fue sustituido en el descanso y ante la Real Sociedad apenas jugó 6 minutos. En los tres últimos se quedó en el banquillo. Claudio Giráldez explica los motivos: “No ha tenido un problema físico pero ha hecho un esfuerzo para poder estar los primeros partidos de Liga, sin estar del todo preparado por una pretemporada prácticamente nula entre que se incorporó un poco más tarde y ha tenido molestias de espalda toda la pretemporada. Le hemos forzado a jugar minutos y decidimos parar un poco para que pueda acumular sesiones sin dolor y que pueda estar en disposición de darnos su mejor nivel. Es un jugador de mi máxima confianza. Son cuestiones de estados de forma o pequeñas molestias que te impiden estar a tu mejor nivel pero no me cabe duda que lo tendrá pronto".

articles.title: Fran González regresa de la concentración con España sub 21
articles.standfirst: El meta leonés sufre una pequeña molestia en el psoas y será examinado en Sevilla
articles.summary: El meta leonés sufre una pequeña molestia en el psoas y será examinado en Sevilla
articles.body: Fran González ha regresado de la concentración con la selección española sub 21 y se reincorpora hoy a la disciplina del Sevilla. El guardameta leonés sufre una pequeña molestia en el psoas de la que será explorado por los servicios médicos del club blanquirrojo. El cancerbero queda pendiente de evolución, como refleja la web oficial de la entidad nervionense. En la comunicación de la RFEF se indica que los servicios médicos de la Federación han estado en permanente contacto con sus homólogos del Sevilla, a los que han mantenido informados sobre el estado de su portero. En la misma información se indica que Fran González ha sido sustituido en la convocatoria por el guardameta del Betis Manu González, que había sido convocado por la RFEF para jugar el encuentro amistoso de la selección española sub 20 frente a México mañana miércoles 30 de septiembre en el Cerro del Espino de Majadahonda (ciudad deportiva del Atlético de Madrid). Fran González se convirtió en el sexto fichaje del Sevilla tras las incorporaciones de Juan Iglesias, Guridi, Sangante, Julio Díaz y Odysseas. Los hispalenses se hicieron con los servicios del guardameta mediante un traspaso de un millón de euros más variables a cambio del 50% de sus derechos, además de varias cláusulas de recompra en las próximas tres ventanas de mercado, por un precio que va desde los tres hasta los cinco millones, incluidas en el acuerdo entre ambos clubes. Se trata de una fórmula similar a la empleada para fichar a Julio Díaz y habitual en las operaciones del Real Madrid.

articles.title: England Women: Ella Toone and Chloe Kelly miss out as Sarina Wiegman names squad to face Greece in World Cup qualifiers
articles.summary: England manager Sarina Wiegman has named a 23-player squad for next month’s World Cup qualifying play-off against Greece; Ella Toone and Chloe Kelly not included; captain Leah Williamson returns after missing June's fixtures with injury
articles.body:
Kelly has yet to complete 90 minutes for Arsenal this season and has not started a game. The last time she was not called up by England was February 2025.

Midfielder Toone has also missed out on a place despite starting three of United's Women's Super League fixtures, although she did not feature in their 1-1 draw with Arsenal on September 19.

"The main reason is that I think the levels weren't what I expect from them on the pitch," explained Wiegman of her decision to leave out Kelly and Toone.

"I have had a conversation with them and there is big competition going on and that is basically what it is.

"It has been a really hard decision for both of them. I really believe in them and we follow them really well and we expect a bit more and know they can bring more.

"I hope they can step up and show what they can do because I'm convinced they can do better. They took the feedback well, in a positive way, but it is also hard to take. It is not a nice message.

"I hope they respond on it really well. I hope they come back even better than they were before.

"I had the conversation with Chloe and it was just about what I saw on the pitch. I kept with football with her [and Toone]."

As well as that pair, Chelsea forward Aggie Beever-Jones and the Arsenal's Lotte Wubben-Moy and Taylor Hinds have also been omitted from the squad.

However, captain Leah Williamson , 29, does return after missing June's 4-0 defeat by Spain and the 3-0 victory over Ukraine with a hamstring injury.

Meanwhile, Chelsea midfielder Lexi Potter earns her first call-up to the senior squad. The 20-year-old has started three of her side's first four games and was on the scoresheet in their 2-0 victory over Birmingham earlier this month.

Wiegman added: "I think she's grown a lot. Last season we kept a close eye on her because she was already getting into the squad but I think she has started this season really well.

"Her performances have really impressed us, so she really deserves this call-up. She's showed at Chelsea she can start against any team.

"What I've seen from her is she comes out on the pitch and just plays, she is comfortable, so I hope to see that next week."

And there is also return for both Liverpool defender Grace Fisk and the uncapped North Carolina Courage midfielder Erica Meg Parkinson after her debut in April, while Manchester City full-back Niamh Charles also makes the squad having made her comeback from injury as a substitute in the WSL champions' 1-0 win over Charlton Athletic on Saturday.

England face a double header against Greece, first at the Pankritio Stadium in Crete on October 9, before the return meeting at Leicester City's King Power Stadium on October 13.

Should the European champions, who were runners-up at the 2023 World Cup, progress to the second round of the World Cup play-offs, they will face either Slovakia or Ukraine over two legs during the final international window of the year in November and December.

The winners at that stage will secure qualification for next summer's tournament in Brazil.

"We have great respect for Greece but our expectations of ourselves are clear," said Wiegman. "We are here to win these two games, deliver strong performances, and move one step closer to securing our place at the World Cup.

"It's always exciting to reconnect as a group and we are looking forward to getting back together. The players will arrive motivated and ready for the next steps.

"We are looking forward to travelling to Crete and playing Greece for the first time ever. We will then return to Leicester, where we've enjoyed some good moments together in the past. We know our supporters will get behind the team again, and it will be great to play in front of them after a few months away."

Wiegman tight-lipped on new England deal

Wiegman is under contract until the end of next summer's World Cup and is yet to agree a new deal which would see her stay beyond 2027.

The 56-year-old was asked in Tuesday's press conference if there has been any progression on a contract extension, but said she is totally focused on the upcoming playoff games with Greece.

She added: "We have regular conversations together and talk about the future at moments, but at this moment I'm just focusing on Greece and want to get through and qualify for the World Cup.

"We always speak. Of course I talk to Mark [Bullingham, FA chief executive officer] every two weeks, and we talk about what is happening now and the future, but there is nothing new, we are focusing on Greece and then hopefully the World Cup."

'The numbers don't lie for Toone and Kelly'

Sarina Wiegman will not have wanted to leave out two of her most trusted players, but the numbers do not lie when it comes to Ella Toone and Chloe Kelly.

Toone has struggled to find her form under new Manchester United head coach Eva Olid, with almost every key metric expected of a midfielder trending down.

It was therefore no surprise to see her left out of the WSL game against Arsenal. Toone has struggled to produce the moments of magic we have become so accustomed to seeing from her this season.

For Kelly, her lack of starts at Arsenal has ultimately caught up with her. Her only starts came in the 0-0 draw at home to Crystal Palace and the narrow win over HB Koge, although she was substituted with the game still goalless.

Kelly was left out four months before Euro 2025, but fought her way back into the squad and went on to become one of the heroes of England's successful campaign.

She will be hoping for a similar journey this time around, as will Toone.

articles.title: In FIFA-UEFA tussle, European body accused of ‘misinformation campaign’
articles.summary: FIFA accuses UEFA of attempting to influence its presidential election, in which Infantino is seeking a fourth term.
articles.body:
FIFA has accused European football’s governing body, UEFA , of waging a “misinformation campaign” and trying to influence the race for its presidency amid a growing governance crisis in the sport.

Football’s global governing body urged a court in the United States on Tuesday to reject UEFA’s ⁠⁠discovery request linked to FIFA president Gianni Infantino’s controversial investment proposal for rights to the World Cup.

Last month, UEFA asked a US federal court for permission to obtain testimony and documents for use in a planned criminal complaint in Switzerland against Infantino over a now-abandoned plan to transfer ⁠⁠World Cup commercial rights into a subsidiary called FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE).

In its response, FIFA said UEFA’s brief contained “numerous false or misleading statements about FIFA and Infantino”.

“With no basis whatsoever, UEFA suggests that Mr Infantino sought to profit personally from the FFE proposal,” FIFA said in a filing in the Southern District of Florida, opposing UEFA’s motion for discovery.

“As explained, the FFE plan was subject to approval ‌‌by both the FIFA member associations and FIFA Council, and FFE would have been subject to oversight by both groups within FIFA,” it said.

“UEFA’s suggestions that Mr Infantino violated any law or ethical principle are categorically without merit.”

UEFA alleged Infantino developed the proposal in secret with a small group of advisers and investors, bypassing the global body’s normal governance processes and failing to consult FIFA Council, regional confederations or member associations.

The European body said in the legal ⁠⁠filing that investors would have paid $4.2bn for a stake in FFE, valuing ⁠⁠the business at about $20bn.

It said the valuation significantly undervalued FIFA’s commercial rights and alleged it had not been subjected to an open auction or tested by an independent valuer.

“UEFA, whether deliberately or through ignorance, conflates equity value with enterprise value,” FIFA said.

“It is undisputed that FFE’s ‘initial equity valuation’ — meaning ‘the ⁠⁠value that remains for the shareholders after any debts have been paid off’ — was $20 billion … Materials distributed to FIFA’s member associations reveal that FFE’s total ‘enterprise value’ on the other hand — meaning the ‘entire ⁠⁠value of the business’ — was well over $30 billion.”

“Indeed, FFE’s enterprise value was well ⁠⁠in excess of twice the equity value, and therefore far above the value UEFA says would be fair.”

The FFE project was abandoned in July following opposition from confederations, including UEFA, the Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football and the Asian Football Confederation, over a lack of consultation, with the dispute fuelling demands for ‌‌changes to FIFA’s governance.

Last week, Infantino wrote to all 211 member associations proposing an independent review of the governing body’s decision-making processes.

The Swiss administrator is up for re-election in March, and FIFA has alleged that UEFA’s legal filings are an attempt ‌‌to ‌‌influence that election.

“Just before FIFA’s election, UEFA filed this 1782 Application (and three others) spreading misinformation regarding Mr Infantino,” FIFA said.

“This court should reject any attempt to influence FIFA’s presidential election based on these grounds.”

Earlier on Monday, Infantino said he was willing ‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌to discuss the disbursement of millions of dollars to ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠its member associations with the exact ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠amount of the distributions to individual nations set to be on the agenda of the FIFA Council’s October 15 meeting.

articles.title: The rise of a new soccer star: Who is US teenager Cavan Sullivan?
articles.summary: Americans often say they need to see a superstar to fall in love with a sport, and for years soccer has come up just short in the US. But now, the nation has a new star breaking through: 17-year-old Cavan Sullivan.
articles.body: Americans often say they need to see a superstar to fall in love with a sport, and for years, soccer has come up just short in the US. We had the likes of Clint Dempsey in the past, a clinical Premier League player but not quite the level of a superstar. Next up was Christian Pulisic, dubbed Captain America, who is arguably a bit better but struggles with consistency. But now, following those halcyon World Cup days on home soil, the US has a new star breaking through: 17-year-old Cavan Sullivan. The Philly native has long been on the radar of soccer lovers, ever since he made his Major League Soccer (MLS) debut for Philadelphia Union at just 14. A record deal at his hometown club followed, as was a reported agreement with Manchester City to sign with the Premier League giant when he’s 18. Now, just one year away from that potential move, he’s making waves at the senior level and is now starring for the US Men’s National Team (USMNT). It looks as though all that potential is now starting to be realized. An electric talent Expectation has followed Sullivan since he was even younger than he is now, and it’s not hard to see why. The attacking midfielder, who can play centrally or drift in from the right flank, is box office when he’s in possession. On a basic level, his foundations are elite. The ball sticks to his foot in possession and he has that explosive movement that terrifies defenders. He’s so much sharper than most, able to dart in any direction to evade danger. But it’s his creativity that sets him apart from other youngsters coming through the ranks. When the ball is at his feet, you get the sense that anything can happen. There are training videos online of Sullivan producing skills and tricks that don’t even have names yet. It’s a kind of talent that sells tickets and has caught the attention of USMNT head coach Mauricio Pochettino as he starts a new World Cup cycle. The teenager, who has excelled for The Union by scoring seven goals and providing 12 assists in MLS this season, was called up to his first national camp this month and made his international debut in the US’ 4-1 thrashing of Peru on Saturday. Sullivan was selected as a starter for that match, showing just how much faith Pochettino has in the emerging talent, who only turned 17 on Monday. “I’m so happy with his performance, I feel really proud,” Pochettino said afterwards. “At 16 years old, performing, fighting and playing with personality, with character.” Family influence That character is no fluke – it’s the product of his upbringing in Philadelphia and molded by the soccer-obsessed household he grew up in. Both of his parents played at collegiate level and the youngest of four brothers followed in the footsteps of his three older siblings, all of whom play the Beautiful Game. Cavan’s brother Quinn also plays professionally for the same club, the pair regularly turning out together for the U this season. But it was at childhood club FC Delco, on the outskirts of Philadelphia, where Sullivan made his first steps as a future soccer prodigy. Rob Elliot, general manager of FC Delco, has seen all the Sullivan boys pass through the various age groups at some point and has known the family for several years. For him, though, it was clear the youngest son was that little bit more special. “Cavan must have been like nine years old, maybe something like that, but obviously back then, he was still a special talent,” Elliot tells CNN Sports. “Every once in a while, some of these kids that come through are just built differently, right? Their mentality, their focus on what they do, it’s just different.” Elliot says Sullivan started playing on the same team as his brothers, who were two years older than him, but he was still able to make an impact despite being so much younger than his teammates and the opposition. It was the youngest Sullivan’s mentality that stood out most to Elliot in those early years – a ‘watch-this’ attitude that was rooted not in ego, but in hard work and perseverance. He remembers getting Sullivan to write down his goals for the future. “Win the World Cup for FC Delco,” Sullivan wrote. And while that might not be possible, a career full of glittering moments isn’t a stretch for a player with so much talent and potential. “He just was fearless about it. It didn’t matter what you threw in front of him, he was gonna attack it,” Elliot adds. “In some ways, you don’t know any better at those ages, but you put a challenge in front of him, and he’s gonna figure out a way to tackle that challenge.” Signs of a star That was evident over the weekend when Sullivan made his debut for the US men’s team. Despite not registering a goal or an assist in just over an hour on the pitch, the youngster was never afraid to receive the ball and try to make something happen. At one point, he was shown a yellow card for a late challenge on Peru’s goalkeeper, an incident that made opposition players protest in his face. Sullivan’s response? Calmly walking away from the scene without looking fazed at all. That reaction spoke volumes about the sort of player he’ll develop into. It’s a cutting edge that makes him that little bit more special than the host of other youngsters coming through the US system at the moment. It’s also an attitude that looked ever so familiar for Elliot. “I remember he was playing against a kid two years older than him, probably a foot taller than him, and they get into a crunching tackle,” Elliot says, recalling a time when he knew Sullivan was destined for big things. “This kid probably weighed 30 or 40 pounds more than him, but Cavan didn’t care. He went full into the tackle, got up, and stood over the kid as if to say, ‘Don’t mess with me,’ kind of thing. “He’s really competitive, but he knows how to walk the line because he’s a really bright kid – just not backing down from anything.” It’s incredible to think that Elliot first met Sullivan before he even became a teenager. And yet less than five years later, the youngster was making his MLS debut. That’s a rapid journey that can come with pitfalls – many young stars have been put on a pedestal and failed to deliver on that promise. But Elliot is highly complimentary of the way Philadelphia Union has handled the youngster since he left FC Delco to join the MLS club’s academy in 2020. Sullivan, for example, has never forgotten his roots and has been back to watch his former childhood team play since moving on, even joining sessions with his former teammates. “He’s a soccer junkie,” Elliot says, laughing. “But he’s still a down-to-earth kid. Obviously, he’s got to deal with a lot of things that 17-year-old kids don’t have to deal with, right? But he’s brought up well, his parents have done a really good job, and again, I think the Union and everyone else around him have done a good job of staying true to who he is. “I don’t think that will change for him. You know, he loves playing.” Sullivan might get another chance to shine for the national team later on Tuesday as the USMNT faces Chile in a friendly. And while his profile continues to rise and expectations increase, you get the sense that this precocious young talent has the ability to keep improving. The eyes of the world are already watching.

articles.title: La RFEF rinde homenaje a Caparrós
articles.standfirst: Una delegación encabezada por Rafael Louzán ha visitado la ciudad deportiva del Sevilla
articles.summary: Una delegación encabezada por Rafael Louzán ha visitado la ciudad deportiva del Sevilla
articles.body: Una delegación de la RFEF, encabezada por su presidente Rafael Louzán, ha visitado esta mañana al presidente de honor sevillista, Joaquín Caparrós, en la Ciudad Deportiva José Ramón Cisneros Palacios. El utrerano, que se encuentra en tratamiento médico, ha sido homenajeado en las horas previas del encuentro que esta noche disputarán España y Croacia en el Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán a las 20.45 horas. Junto a Caparrós también ha estado presente el presidente del Sevilla, José María del Nido Carrasco, mientras que a Louzán lo acompañaron el presidente de la Real Federación Andaluza, Pedro Curtido, así como por la vocal de la Junta de la RFEF Minerva Salas. Tras el breve encuentro y el intercambio de obsequios, tuvo lugar un posado con las camisetas del Sevilla y la Selección. Caparrós, incansable defensor de la cantera nervionense, contribuyó en su carrera a la formación de campeones del Mundo con España. Jesús Navas y Sergio Ramos debutaron en la élite cuando defendían los colores del Sevilla. Otros como Capdevila y Arbeloa, ambos campeones de la Copa del Mundo de 2010, también crecieron en el Deportivo durante la etapa de Caparrós en Riazor. Además, Vicente del Bosque seleccionó a Llorente y Javi Martínez mientras eran entrenados por el utrerano en el primer equipo del Athletic.

articles.title: Diarra se rompe y obliga a reinventar el centro del campo del Córdoba
articles.standfirst: El jugador maliense estará "un periodo de recuperación prolongado" de baja, quizá varios meses incluso, por una lesión en la musculatura isquiosural
articles.summary: El jugador maliense estará "un periodo de recuperación prolongado" de baja, quizá varios meses incluso, por una lesión en la musculatura isquiosural
articles.body: El Córdoba conoció este martes que Yussi Diarra, uno de los jugadores fijos en el esquema de Iván Ania en el arranque liguero, sufre una lesión que "requerirá un periodo de recuperación prolongado", según el parte de los servicios médicos del club. Pese a no especificar la duración, podría ser cosa incluso no ya de semanas, sino de meses. El maliense, que regresó este verano a la entidad cedido por el Cádiz, presenta "una lesión en la musculatura isquiosural de su pierna derecha de afectación tendinosa". Tuvo que ser sustituido en el minuto 66 del partido ante el Valladolid y, se dice, ya ha iniciado su proceso de recuperación "bajo seguimiento conjunto de los servicios médicos de ambos clubes". Pese a que el futbolista había bajado su nivel en los últimos partidos, y de hecho contra el Almería recibió una dura pitada de la afición al ser sustituido, su baja genera un problema importante para Iván Ania, que valoraba mucho la capacidad con y sin balón del centrocampista. Habrá que ver si Theo Zidane, que tuvo sus primeros minutos precisamente en Pucela, o Eder García, que había sido titular hasta ese encuentro, pueden adaptarse a lo que el entrenador ovetense exige a sus centrocampistas para acompañar al intocable Isma Ruiz. Por otro lado, el club informó de que este viernes realizará un sencillo acto de homenaje para dar el nombre de Rafael Campanero, su presidente de honor fallecido el 19 de junio de 2022, a la Puerta 00 del Bahrain Victorious Nuevo Arcángel. Con ello quiere "preservar su historia, reconocer a quienes han contribuido a construir la identidad de la entidad blanquiverde y reforzar la cultura de club", en este caso de un hombre cuya gestión permitió subsistir a la entidad en algunos de sus peores momentos y que fue clave para el ascenso a Primera en 1971, a Segunda B en 1985 y a Segunda en 2007.

articles.title: Rooney no quiere los títulos: "No me sentiría cómodo aceptando otra medalla de la Premier League"
articles.standfirst: El exfutbolista del Manchester United no comparte la opinión del resto de futbolistas que reclaman que le quiten los títulos al City
articles.summary: El exfutbolista del Manchester United no comparte la opinión del resto de futbolistas que reclaman que le quiten los títulos al City
articles.body: El caos desatado por la situación del Manchester City ha provocado que muchos personajes con los que se han cruzado a lo largo de estos años pidan 'justicia'. Varios pedían que les retiren los títulos y otorguen los premios a los subcampeones. El que fue central del United, Rio Ferdinand, apuntó directamente contra un compatriota que jugaba en el otro equipo de la ciudad, Joleon Lescott. En su canal de Youtube Rio Ferdinand Presenta, dijo que quería su medalla, correspondiente a la Premier de la temporada 11/12, que el City ganó con el gol de Agüero en los últimos minutos. "Cuando vea a Joleon, de hecho voy a ir a su casa y simplemente decirle: 'Escucha, entrégala. Entrégala'. No puedes sentarte ahí y decir realmente que fuiste campeón, ¿verdad? O que ganaste eso o aquello. No van a tener que pagar ninguna multa. No van a descender. Simplemente entregad el trofeo. Entregad las medallas, entregad el trofeo. Así de simple", afirmó. En el partido entre España e Inglaterra de la Nations League, Roy Keane, Ian Wright y Juan Mata, comentaristas de ITV, dieron su opinión respecto al tema. "Fue su decisión: el club optó por hacer trampa. Sea lo que sea que hayan ganado en los últimos años, merecen ser castigados. Obviamente, es difícil determinar dónde empezar y dónde terminar con eso. Pero hicieron trampa y fueron declarados culpables de ello", expresó Keane. "Claro que no pueden quitarles esa experiencia. Pero deberían quitársela. Deberían ser castigados por ello. Puede que hayan podido revivir esos recuerdos y esos grandes momentos juntos, pero cuando ves a los equipos que intentaban alcanzarlos y que lo estaban haciendo bien... Hicieron trampa para conseguirlo y mucha gente se lo ha perdido; los jugadores se han perdido oportunidades increíbles", fue la opinión de Wright. Mata sería uno de los favorecidos si deciden despojar al City de los títulos ganados. "He tenido la suerte de jugar muchos partidos y ganar algunos trofeos. Pero nunca gané la Premier League... ¿o sí? Dos veces. Porque en esos años quedamos segundos dos veces. No sé qué va a pasar, pero creo que tienen razón. Quien haya hecho trampa debe ser castigado", dijo el español. Sin embargo, una de las grandes leyendas del United, Wayne Rooney, no sigue la línea de los exfutbolistas mencionados. En el podcast Stick to United, el inglés ha afirmado que no recibiría de buen gusto la medalla de aquella Premier perdida con el gol del argentino. "No me sentiría cómodo aceptando otra medalla de la Premier League siendo honesto, porque no creo que la mereciéramos. Ya que no hicimos lo suficiente esa temporada para ganar la Liga. Creo que teníamos seis o siete puntos de ventaja, falta de cuatro o cinco partidos, algo así, y lo echamos a perder. Entonces, a pesar de saber que hicieron trampa, sigues pensando que 11 contra 11 no fuimos lo suficientemente buenos", declaró. "No quiero recuperar el título. Pero creo que es muy probable que se lo puedan quitar. Pero sientes enojo hacia ellos, porque el fútbol habría cambiado. Me siento triste y decepcionado por eso", añadió. Tocará esperar para ver si hay un castigo para el Manchester City y si al final Rooney, Mata y los demás jugadores y equipos perjudicados son proclamados campeones

articles.title: Worst fantasy football lineup in Week 3: How many players were on your roster?
articles.summary: If you had these players on your roster, you probably had a tough week.
articles.body:
Week 3 of the 2026 fantasy football season produced some truly painful performances, and this lineup managed to combine several of the biggest disappointments into one disastrous starting group. According to DraftKings, this "absolute worst fantasy team of the week" among players you would reasonably consider starting scored just 25.6 total points.

How many of these guys were in your starting lineup? 😭 pic.twitter.com/yNEhp3rbFq — DraftKings (@DraftKings) September 29, 2026

How many of these guys were in your starting lineup? 😭 pic.twitter.com/yNEhp3rbFq

DraftKings (@DraftKings) September 29, 2026

Even worse, there are several players on this list who were almost certainly sitting in starting lineups across fantasy leagues this weekend.

Dec 21, 2025; Miami Gardens, Florida, USA; Miami Dolphins running back De'Von Achane (28) reacts after scoring a touchdown during the first quarter against the Cincinnati Bengals at Hard Rock Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images

At quarterback, Drake Maye led the way with just 6.8 points. The Patriots quarterback threw for 199 yards with two interceptions, lost a fumble, and added 18 rushing yards. It was another frustrating performance from Maye, who struggled to consistently move the New England offense.

The running backs were even more painful.

TreVeyon Henderson managed only 3.9 fantasy points, while De'Von Achane finished with just 1.7 points before suffering a season-ending torn ACL. Achane had only 17 rushing yards in the Dolphins' loss to Kansas City.

At wide receiver, Justin Jefferson scored only 5.2 points, while Tetairoa McMillan managed 3.7. Jefferson's disappointing fantasy outing came despite his prominent role in Minnesota's offense, while McMillan couldn't generate much production for Carolina.

Hunter Henry rounded out the skill-position group with only 1.5 points, while Jalen Coker contributed 3.8 points in the flex.

The kicker and defense made it even worse

The lineup somehow got even more painful from there.

Joey Slye scored just 1.0 fantasy point at kicker, while the Green Bay Packers defense actually finished with -2.0 points .

Put it all together, and the lineup totaled just 25.6 fantasy points .

That's the kind of week where a fantasy manager can look at the box score and wonder how everything went wrong at the same time. The particularly brutal part is that most of these players weren't outrageous starts entering the week. Jefferson, Achane, Henderson, Maye, and Henry were all players fantasy managers could reasonably have put into their lineups.

Achane's situation obviously carries an entirely different context because his season is now over, while Jefferson's status will be closely watched after his ankle injury.

articles.title: Adjusting expectations for Kentucky football after 3-1 start
articles.summary: Kentucky is 3-1 after the first month and ranked in the top 25, we look at adjusting expectations for this football team after a strong start to 2026.
articles.body:
Before we start to preview South Carolina , I thought it would be good to take a look at this Kentucky Wildcats team after the first month of the season. Will Stein has his Wildcats with a 3-1 record and ranked in the top 25 after the month of September. Kentucky has one of the toughest schedules in college football, and we knew that coming in but they have exceeded expectations early. Some of the games on the schedule look a lot different four games into the season, so it is time to adjust expectation for this Kentucky football team in year one under Coach Stein.

Kentucky has the 11th overall SOR (strength of record) to this point, not a lot of teams have played a tougher schedule to start than the Wildcats after playing Alabama and a road trip to Texas A&M . No one expected Kentucky to get an upset in College Station, and it was a dominant victory. Kentucky led the Crimson Tide for 40 of 60 minutes before the game complete flipped and snowballed. There are plenty of reasons the Wildcats are ahead of schedule in year one of the Will Stein era.

Kentucky had high expectations for this offensive line in the offseason, and the coaching staff was not afraid to let people know about it. They struggled at times against Alabama, but this unit has improved every single week. Offensive line coach Cutter Leftwich has done a phenomenal job with this group and stats suggest they are one of the best offensive lines in the country. This is the position group that can allow Kentucky to have a special season and keep winning football games.

Parker Fleming (@statsowar) released a couple of charts on FBS teams, and one in particular shows Kentucky leads the country in Yards Before Contact in the run game. Kentucky is one of just three teams that are averaging over four yards before contact in the country. Kentucky is winning at the point of attack and getting movement at the line of scrimmage that would make the late great offensive line coach John Schlarman proud. They have been pretty exceptional in pass protection as well.

According to PFF, the Wildcats have allowed 14 total sacks, hits and pressures on the quarterback this season; only Missouri has allowed fewer through the first month of the season among SEC teams. PFF also shows that only nine offensive lineman have yet to allow a pressure this season, and Kentucky is the only team with two players on this list. Center Coleton Price and right guard Tegra Tshabola are the two on that list, and all five of Kentucky's offensive lineman were apart of PFF's All-SEC team of the week after their performance against South Alabama . The big blue wall is back.

Kentucky has already shown their proof of concept this season on both sides of the football. Coach Stein has shown his offense allows his quarterback to play efficient and use quick game/RPO schemes to get the ball out quickly to their playmakers. We have seen a ton of eye candy, unique formations and versatile personnel groupings. On opponent adjusted metrics, Kentucky is among the elite groups in EPA/play on offense.

The Wildcats defense have shown proof of concept as well, as Jay Bateman's scheme has shown their versatility with fronts and coverage rotations on the back end. We have seen the simulated pressure looks, one led to a direct interception for Sam Greene against Texas A&M . This defense has done exactly what they said it would be, they have allowed some yards but they are really good at creating havoc plays and turnovers. On opponent adjusted metrics, Kentucky's defense is also among the elite groups in EPA/play on defense.

We saw the proof of concept play out in College Station. Kentucky's offense was dominant, efficient and we saw Kenny Minchey look like a high level quarterback. Kentucky's defense allowed yardage, but made game changing plays and rattled quarterback Marcel Reed . The third quarter against Texas A&M was the best quarter of football in Kentucky's program history .

Kentucky's October looks a lot different than it did in July, as they have a massive road game on Saturday against a South Carolina team that is reeling in pretty much every aspect. LSU will come to town as Kentucky brings back the beloved Power K, and the Tigers have lost a few key starters over the past two weeks. Oklahoma is one of the more shocking disappointments in the SEC, and they have a lot to do to turn this season around. Vanderbilt has regressed with Diego Pavia , and getting them at home is one of the few games left that Kentucky will be favored in.

There is a real chance Kentucky goes 3-1 in October like they did in September, which would set the Wildcats up for a massive November. Kentucky has a tough road trip to Neyland Stadium off of the bye week, and then they host Jon Sumrall's Florida Gators who look unbelievable to start. A road trip to Missouri is interesting, weird things happen in CoMo, but this is a winnable game for Kentucky. Then they end the season against Louisville for the Governor's Cup, and the Cardinals playoff hopes may already be dead following a home loss to Wake Forest.

Kentucky has a real chance to go 8-4 in Will Stein's first season. I think this team has a lot of advantages on the line of scrimmage moving forward, which cannot be overstated. The Wildcats need to win this weekend against the Gamecocks and set up a phenomenal environment when they host LSU. Kentucky has a great opportunity ahead of them, but they have to get the win this weekend as it is maybe the most important game on the schedule.
